The quotient structure arises from collapsing fine-grained concrete distinctions into coarse abstract classes. In particular, the pending count abstraction groups all counts ≥2 into a single GE2 class, since only ≤1 vs ≥2 matters for safety. This is justified by the AtMostOnePendingPerInvocation invariant, which ensures that any state violating this condition is structurally unreachable. The phase partitioning further refines the state space by separating claim and exposure phases, preserving key distinctions such as frozen vs live status and fingerprint binding, but abstracting away reasons for freezing. These abstractions enable compositional reasoning where the safety argument in the abstract lifts to the concrete via the refinement mapping α. The resulting quotient structure supports both formal verification and practical inference by ensuring that safety invariants hold in the concrete model when they are satisfied in the abstract.
